messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi there! I’m having trouble sending MMS messages from my phone. It’s been happening for the past few hours, and I’d really like to get it working again. Can you help me figure out what’s going on?

To assist you with the MMS messaging issue, I first need to identify you as a customer. Could you please provide me with your phone number, or your full name along with your date of birth? This will help me look up your account and check your line status and settings.
Sure! My name is John Smith and my phone number is 555-123-2002. Let me know if you need any more information from me.

Thank you, John. I have identified your account. To troubleshoot the MMS sending issue, I will first check the status of your phone's cellular service and mobile data, as these are prerequisites for MMS to work. Then, I will check the MMS capability on your phone.

I will start by checking the status bar on your phone to see the current cellular and data status.
It looks like my phone is currently in Airplane Mode. What should I do next to try and fix the MMS issue?

Since your phone is currently in Airplane Mode, this disables all wireless communications including cellular service and mobile data, which will prevent MMS from working.

Please turn off Airplane Mode on your phone. This should restore cellular service and mobile data connectivity, which are necessary for sending MMS messages.

After turning off Airplane Mode, please let me know so I can guide you through the next steps to ensure MMS works properly.

Airplane Mode is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I've turned off Airplane Mode. My status bar now shows excellent signal strength, 5G, and that mobile data is enabled. What should I do next?

Your line is active and mobile data is enabled with excellent signal strength on 5G, which is good for MMS.

Next, I will check if your phone's messaging app can send MMS messages properly.
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.
It looks like my messaging app still can’t send MMS messages, even though mobile data is on and I have a good signal. What should I try next?

Since your messaging app still cannot send MMS messages despite having good signal and mobile data, the next step is to check your phone's APN (Access Point Name) settings. Incorrect APN settings, especially the MMSC URL, are a common cause of MMS issues.

I will guide you to check and if needed, reset your APN settings to default. After resetting, you will need to reboot your device for the changes to take effect.

Would you like me to proceed with checking your APN settings?

Current APN Name: internet
MMSC URL (for picture messages): http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc
(These are technical settings, usually best left unchanged.)

I’ve checked my APN settings. The APN name is set to “internet” and the MMSC URL is “http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc.” Are these the correct settings, or should I reset them to default as you suggested?

The APN name "internet" and the MMSC URL "http://mms.carrier.com/mms/wapenc" appear to be set, but I cannot verify if they are correct or not from here.

Since you are still unable to send MMS messages, it is a good idea to reset your APN settings to the default values to ensure they are correct and not corrupted.

Would you like me to guide you through resetting your APN settings to default and then rebooting your device?

APN settings will reset at reboot.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
I've reset my APN settings as you suggested. Should I go ahead and reboot my phone now, or is there anything else I need to do first?

Yes, please go ahead and reboot your phone now. Rebooting is necessary for the APN reset to take effect.

After your phone restarts, try sending an MMS message again and let me know if the issue is resolved or if you need further assistance.

Resetting APN settings...
Restarting network services...
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.
I’ve rebooted my phone, but unfortunately, I still can’t send MMS messages. Is there something else we can try? It’s getting a bit frustrating not being able to send pictures.

I understand the frustration. Let's continue troubleshooting.

Next, I will check if Wi-Fi Calling is enabled on your phone, as it can sometimes interfere with MMS functionality. If it is enabled, I will guide you to disable it and then test MMS again.

Please hold on while I check the Wi-Fi Calling status on your phone.
Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned ON.
Wi-Fi Calling is currently turned on. Should I go ahead and turn it off to see if that helps with sending MMS messages?

Yes, please go ahead and turn off Wi-Fi Calling on your phone. This can sometimes interfere with MMS messaging.

After turning off Wi-Fi Calling, try sending an MMS message again and let me know if it works or if you need further assistance.

Wi-Fi Calling is now OFF.
Status Bar: 📶⁴ Excellent | 5G | 📱 Data Enabled | 🔋 80%
Your messaging app cannot send MMS messages.

Since turning off Wi-Fi Calling did not resolve the MMS issue, the next step is to check if your messaging app has the necessary permissions to send MMS messages, specifically storage and SMS permissions.

I will check the permissions for the messaging app on your phone now.
To proceed with checking the messaging app permissions on your phone, I need to run a diagnostic on your phone to check the app permissions for the messaging app. I will do that now.
